comment: kspcore tolerances for comparisons against the in-game captures (harness/captures/out, CAPTURE-SPEC C1/C2/C7). Same format and first-match semantics as harness/compare/tolerances.json. Coordinator rule: float32 columns may accept at most 64 ULP or rel 5e-6 where bit-exactness is not reached; every relaxation must be listed in STATUS.md. Exception: deltav_readout stage / total delta-v (WP-17, STATUS.md); everything else is exact.

rules.why: Unity managed float maths under Mono's float rule: bit-exact
